title_sq: Shitet Biznes Bar-Restorant, Pas Kullave Binjake Rr Ukraina e Lire!
description_sq:
Restoranti ndodhet ne nje zone strategjike te Tiranes dhe gezon nje emer te mrie ne treg, me nje baze te qendrueshme klientesh dhe prezence te forte ne rrjetet sociale dhe online. Aktiviteti eshte i gatshem per tu marre ne dorezin dhe vazhduar pa anje pengese operacionale.
Ne shitje perfshihet:
Te gjitha asetet materiale (mobilim, paisje profesionale, investar te plote).
Kontrata ekzistuese me furnitore dhe partner, te cilat do transferohen te gjitha.
Emri tregtar Domain-I dhe te gjitha llogarite ne rrjete sociale.
Staf aktual i trajnuar, i cili ka pervoje dhe qendrueshmeri ne pune.
Biznesi ka hyre ne faze qendrueshmerie operimi, me shpenzime te strukturuara dhe rritje progresive te xhiros mujore.
Pozicionimi ne treg dhe reputacioni pozitiv krijojne nje baze te forte per zgjerim te metejshem dhe perfitime te larte.
title_en: Bar-Restaurant Business for sale, Behind the Twin Towers St. Ukraine Free!
description_en: The restaurant is located in a strategic area of ​​Tirana and enjoys a good name in the market, with a stable customer base and a strong presence in social and online networks. The activity is ready to be taken up and continued without any operational obstacles. The sale includes: All material assets (furniture, professional equipment, full investment). Existing contracts with suppliers and partners, which will all be transferred. Domain-I trade name and all social network accounts. Current trained staff, who have experience and stability in work. The business has entered the phase of operational sustainability, with structured expenses and progressive increase in monthly turnover. Positioning in the market and positive reputation create a strong base for further expansion and high profits.
